protocolos.resumen: Acute chest pressure, syncope, arrhythmia, or cardiac arrest in microgravity.
protocolos.equipoUbicacion: AED and pads: Medical Rack B2 · CMRS stretcher: Node 2 · ALSP kit: Red Bag
protocolos.fuente: Hinkelbein et al. (AHA / Aerospace Med CPR 0G) & ISS Medical Checklist (JSC-48522)

pasos.instruccion: Rule out a toxic leak or environmental hypoxia (check cabin O2/CO2). Assess consciousness and breathing in under 10 seconds.
pasos.nota0G: Anchor your feet on the floor rails before touching your crewmate.

pasos.instruccion: Without CMRS straps or feet against the opposite wall (Handstand), compression force pushes the rescuer away by Newton's third law.
pasos.nota0G: If alone without CMRS straps, use Handstand: feet on the upper wall, hands on the sternum, 110 compressions/min at 5–6 cm.

pasos.titulo: AED placement and electrical isolation in 0G
pasos.instruccion: Apply AED pads on a dry chest. Before the shock, verify that no crew member is floating in contact with the patient or the metal structure.
pasos.nota0G: Sweat does not run in 0G: it forms a conductive film over the chest. Dry completely with gauze before applying pads.

pasos.instruccion: Keep the 30:2 ratio. Connect the portable oxygen mask (PBA) and record vital signs every 2 minutes.
pasos.nota0G: Avoid hyperventilation; secure the face seal with the elastic strap.

pasos.titulo: SBAR package for the Flight Surgeon
pasos.instruccion: Transmit the automatic log with UTC timestamps, completed cycles, and the latest OSD-575 baseline when the link window returns.
pasos.nota0G: The package stays in local storage even if console power is lost.

protocolos.resumen: Acute dyspnea, SpO2 below 90%, confusion, or headache from local CO2 accumulation.
protocolos.equipoUbicacion: PBA 100% O2 mask: forward bulkhead · Portable CO2 analyzer: Environmental Rack

pasos.titulo: Place the portable O2 mask (PBA) immediately
pasos.instruccion: Isolate the airway from cabin air before investigating the environmental failure.
pasos.nota0G: In 0G there is no natural convection: CO2 pockets form around the head if ventilation fails.

pasos.titulo: Move to a module with forced ventilation
pasos.instruccion: Move the crew member to an active laminar-flow duct and measure SpO2 and respiratory rate.
pasos.nota0G: Check that the pulse oximeter has good capillary contact.

pasos.titulo: Assess bicarbonate and total blood CO2
pasos.instruccion: Compare with the carbon_dioxide analyte in your personal OSD-575 baseline (20–32 mmol/L).
pasos.nota0G: Store the event in the deferred queue for ground medical control.

protocolos.titulo: Sudden visual change or severe vertigo
protocolos.resumen: Central scotoma, diplopia, severe intracranial headache, or acute spatial disorientation.
protocolos.equipoUbicacion: Amsler grid and ophthalmoscope: Medical Drawer M1 · Soft restraint: Hab Node
protocolos.fuente: NASA HRP SANS Evidence Report & ISS Medical Checklist

pasos.instruccion: Hold the crew member to a fixed point to stop the vestibular-visual conflict in microgravity.

pasos.titulo: Rapid acuity and Amsler grid test
pasos.instruccion: Test each eye at 30 cm and record central line distortion or a blind spot.
Take a capillary glucose and electrolytes (sodium/potassium) and package the results for the Flight Surgeon.
pasos.nota0G: OSD-575 documented glucose values of 36 and 44 mg/dL; always rule out a metabolic cause.

protocolos.resumen: Bleeding control in 0G, CMRS stretcher fixation, and monitoring for rhabdomyolysis or dehydration.
protocolos.equipoUbicacion: Trauma kit and compression bandage: Red Bag · CMRS stretcher: Node 2

pasos.instruccion: Apply hemostatic gauze and an elastic compression bandage while keeping your feet anchored to the rail.
pasos.nota0G: Venous blood forms adherent domes in 0G; use suction or absorbent gauze to avoid floating droplets.

pasos.instruccion: Secure the pelvic and thoracic straps and monitor heart rate and blood pressure every 5 minutes.
pasos.nota0G: Intravascular volume loss is tolerated worse after microgravity adaptation.

pasos.instruccion: Record the OSD-575 panel analytes and package the log for Earth.
